text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: The day of Super Creek's debut is<n>finally here.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But she brushes that aside to<n>celebrate my debut
as a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
However, remembering that she's<n>the one actually
running the race,<n>Super Creek sheepishly heads out
to<n>make me proud.
